claude_proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition in spell Effect type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The initial save gate applies Frightened on a failed save. The current spell Effect type is DamageEffect | NoneEffect. The mastery surface already has apply_condition as a SaveGateRiderResult variant, but spells have no equivalent. Encoding the condition application honestly requires widening the spell Effect discriminated union.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, a target takes 10d10 Psychic damage and has the Frightened condition for the duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: frightened in Condition type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type currently only includes 'prone'. Weird's primary ongoing rider is gated on the Frightened condition, which must be representable in the closed Condition union before any condition-applying or condition-checking surface type can reference it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: a target...has the Frightened condition for the duration. A Frightened target makes a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: per-turn repeat save gated on applied condition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Frightened targets make a WIS save at the end of each of their turns for the spell's duration: failing deals 5d10 psychic, succeeding ends the spell on that target. This is a repeat_save (v4 resolution atom) fired by a turn_end_window, gated on the condition the spell itself applied, and terminates per-target on success. No existing spell family (activation, ongoing_effect, triggered_reaction, anchored_trigger) can express this shape. 'activation' phases are sequential and one-shot; 'ongoing_effect' operations are limited to roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. A new family or cross-family composition is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A Frightened target makes a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failed save, it takes 5d10 Psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends on that target.
